patientid.description: Unique identifier for each patient record.

age.description: Patient age in years at the time of examination.

gender.description: Sex of the patient; 0 and 1 represent two categories (commonly 0 = female, 1 = male).
needs_verification: Exact mapping of 0/1 to female/male is assumed from common heart‑disease datasets; confirm with source documentation.

chestpain.description: Type of chest pain experienced, encoded as an integer from 0‑3 (e.g., typical angina, atypical angina, non‑anginal pain, asymptomatic).
needs_verification: Specific meaning of each integer code should be verified against the original dataset codebook.

restingBP.description: Resting systolic blood pressure measured at admission.

needs_verification: Unit assumed to be mg/dL, as typical for serum cholesterol; confirm with data source.

fastingbloodsugar.description: Indicator of fasting blood sugar > 120 mg/dL (1 = true, 0 = false).
needs_verification: Threshold (120 mg/dL) is inferred from the classic UCI heart‑disease dataset; verify against the dataset documentation.

restingrelectro.description: Resting electrocardiographic results coded as 0‑2 (normal, ST‑T wave abnormality, left ventricular hypertrophy).
needs_verification: Exact mapping of codes to ECG findings should be cross‑checked with the original codebook.

maxheartrate.description: Maximum heart rate achieved during exercise stress test.

oldpeak.description: ST‑segment depression induced by exercise relative to rest (the ‘oldpeak’ value).
needs_verification: Unit is commonly recorded in millimetres of ST depression; confirm with source.

slope.description: Slope of the peak exercise ST segment, coded as 0‑3 (upsloping, flat, downsloping, unknown).
needs_verification: Exact textual meaning of each integer value should be validated.

noofmajorvessels.description: Number of major coronary vessels (0‑3) with significant narrowing as seen on fluoroscopy.

target.description: Presence of heart disease (1 = disease, 0 = no disease).

cholesterol_missing.description: Binary flag indicating whether serum cholesterol value is missing (1 = missing, 0 = present).
